Doctorate
On these pages, doctoral candidates will find the most important procedures of a doctoral procedure at KIT, the acceptance as a doctoral candidate at the beginning of the doctorate and the admission to the doctoral procedure after writing the dissertation.
If you cannot find answers to your questions in the FAQ section, please contact the doctoral office or other contact persons. The Convention of Doctoral Researchers represents the interests of all doctoral candidates at KIT.
Detailed information on doctoral procedures at the KIT Department of Mechanical Engineering can be found in the doctoral regulations, regulations for the award of a/the doctoral degree (2017) and its amendment statutes (2018)
